title.narrative: Provision of health care and water services for the displaced, Saada governorate, Razih district

description.narrative: Providing primary health care services and providing water to (1427) beneficiaries, enabling the medical, technical and assistant staff to have jobs in the clinic and the water project, and providing a safe healthy environment.

Providing primary health care services, trauma treatment and bandages, safe disposal of medical waste and waste, saving and maintaining life, limiting the spread of diseases and epidemics, securing emergency health services and providing water for the displaced in Saada governorate.

Saving life, preserving its continuity, limiting the spread of diseases and epidemics, and securing emergency health services by providing primary health care, injury treatment, bandaging, and safe disposal of medical waste.
